name: Serizawa Aya
source: A heroine of this story. She is the vice president of the class that Tada Hitoshi is in. She has also served in the student council before. She has known Tada for a long time and usually argues with him. Serizawa is quite athletic and is the ace of the women's basketball club. Her body is quite well developed
